official.h: NEW COACHING SCHEME / THE BELGRAVE MASTERS COACHING SCHEME

photos.c: PETER CARTON leads the "Brockman" 800 field at one lap from P. Thomas (7), D. Huffer (11) and J. Sullivan (6). Peter finished 2nd (1:56.3) behind Thomas (1:55.3).

One feature of our Southern League appearances this year has been the faithful band of loyal supporters who have provided the Belgrave team with superb support. Here we see the main ringleaders getting ready for the fray. Yes, your quite right. There's the Couzens, the Pritchards and who's that under the hedge? Quite right it's Bon Viveur and Carshalton Playboy -Ian Richley. But, have you spotted the two Coaches. Yes, the're there-Mick Dunphy and John Sullivan.....So how about a caption for this fine photo -?? The best versions will be printed in the next issue of the BELGRAVIAN.

The officials, pictured left, were (from the top left to right): Gordon Biscoe (timekeeper), John Sullivan (North London timekeeper), Don Anderson (timekeeper), Yak Stegner (Herne Hill timekeeper), Terry Earle (timekeeper), Pat Mead (track referee), Stuart Bennett (track judge), Bob Bridges (timekeeper), Richard Biscoe (track judge), Alan Mead (chief timekeeper), Leslie Earle (track judge). Not pictured but recording entries and assisting with the seeding was John Jeffery while starter was Bob Bush (Serpentine).
